correctness.rationale: Forth-up forces any A-to-B target into the unique greatest equivalence class of within-B modal preorder Q_B; forth-down dually forces each B-to-A target into Top(Q_A). Modal transitivity enforces predecessor-closed source sets U and V, and saturation over each top class; these constraints are sufficient: within-level transitivity, mixed compositions into downward-closed blocks, alternating compositions into the original preorders, and both confluences can be checked directly. The parametrization is injective with empty-set convention for absent top classes. The four disjoint cases on existence of top classes yield the stated product-sum N_pq formula. Independent enumerations of labelled preorders on up to four points gave P2/G2/T2/E2 = 4/3/12/8 and P3/G3/T3/E3 = 29/16/130/59, verified the N22=89, N23=762, N33=5922,N24=11534,N44=1062296 calculations and independently compared the complete literal S4I relation set for p=q=2 with the normal form (89 exact matches). These finite calculations are corroboration; the unrestricted proof handles p,q>=2.
residual_risks: Only labelled infallible frames with fixed complete bipartite height-two intuitionistic order. The numbers are not isomorphism classes nor universal S4I frame counts.

originality.rationale: Balbiani–Diéguez–Fernández-Duque 2021 introduce S4I semantics and prove finite-model results, and Balbiani et al. 2024 refine finite birelational-frame techniques, but the relevant texts do not state this normal form or enumeration on a complete two-antichain intuitionistic order. The closest published Resultary finite-chain KI/IFS descriptions have different confluence hypotheses or nonbranching intuitionistic reduct; they do not imply a two-sided branching preorder census. The classification is a separate combinatorial result, though older order-theoretic descriptions of bi-preorder confluence remain a bounded priority risk.
residual_risks: An older equivalence under alternate modal/intuitionistic relation directions or preorder enumeration terminology could preempt originality; not identified here.

Classification depends on both confluence axioms and greatest SCCs; this does not follow from a chain formula
value.rationale: Complete two-level antichain orders are the simplest natural intuitionistic posets with genuine branching at both levels. A uniform normal form reducing all S4I modal preorders to two arbitrary within-level preorders plus two downsets gives a constructive exact two-parameter census useful for model-generation and verification. The nontrivial exact counts are not mere small-instance recomputations and need no wider decidability breakthrough to matter.
residual_risks: Does not classify arbitrary incidence posets, frame isomorphism classes, or logic-theoretic complexity.
